{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: "Test Suite"
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:

jobs:
  msrv:
    name: Determine MSRV
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      msrv: ${{ steps.msrv.outputs.msrv }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - id: msrv
        run: echo "msrv=$(grep '^rust-version' Cargo.toml | sed 's/.*\"\(.*\)\"/\1/')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  test:
    needs: msrv
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu
          - macos
          - windows
        toolchain:
          - stable
          - ${{ needs.msrv.outputs.msrv }}
    name: cargo test on ${{ matrix.os }}, rust ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ matrix.toolchain }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.toml', '**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ matrix.toolchain }}-
      - name: Cargo test
        run: cargo test --workspace --all-targets
      - name: Cargo doc test
        run: cargo test --doc

  # Check for clippy warnings
  clippy:
    name: Cargo clippy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          components: clippy
      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ubuntu-cargo-stable-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.toml', '**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ubuntu-cargo-stable-
      - name: Cargo clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets
        env:
          RUSTFLAGS: "" # Don't make test fail on clippy

  # Verify that timely_communication, timely, and the threadless example
  # continue to compile for wasm32-unknown-unknown. The threadless example
  # documents the WASM-compatible entry point: a single-threaded worker
  # constructed manually with no timer. This job catches regressions that
  # would break that path (e.g. introducing a hard dependency on
  # std::net APIs that don't compile, or removing Option<Instant> from
  # Worker::new).
  wasm:
    name: Cargo check (wasm32-unknown-unknown)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          target: wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ubuntu-cargo-wasm-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.toml', '**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ubuntu-cargo-wasm-
      - name: Check timely_communication
        run: cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p timely_communication
      - name: Check timely
        run: cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p timely
      - name: Check threadless example
        run: cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p timely --example threadless
      - name: Check wasm-bindgen example
        run: cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path timely/examples/wasm-bindgen/Cargo.toml",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs cargo test, clippy, and wasm checks across multiple OS/toolchain combinations without caching Cargo dependencies. Each job repeatedly fetches the same registry and git dependencies. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency_cache) supports caching dependency download state with lockfile/environment as cache inputs, preserving all required checks and test coverage. Adding actions/cache for ~/.cargo/registry and ~/.cargo/git, keyed by runner OS, toolchain, and hash of Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, reduces repeated dependency fetching on warm runs while leaving every build and test step unchanged. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or deployment operations are added, and no new network access beyond the existing cache action is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
